description: Header file defining classes and templates for managing dynamic argument lists and storage for a C++ formatting library, including handling of reference wrappers, argument unwrapping, and argument storage with support for small string optimization.

classes.name: node
classes.description: A template struct representing a node in a linked list, with a virtual destructor and a unique pointer to the next node.

classes.name: dynamic_arg_list
classes.description: A class managing a linked list of typed nodes for storing formatting arguments.

classes.name: dynamic_format_arg_store
classes.description: A class template for storing a dynamic list of formatting arguments with support for small string optimization and argument referencing.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new argument node to the dynamic_arg_list.

methods.name: operator basic_format_args<Context>()
methods.description: Converts the argument store into a format-agnostic argument list.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an argument to the store, with overloads for value, reference, and named arguments.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for a specified number of arguments and named arguments.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of stored arguments.
